entities.name: Enkindi
entities.description: Brave Kor leader of a band of kitesailers on Zendikar who recruited Drana for Gideon's forces.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: Vampire bloodchief leading survivors in Guul Draz.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker whose forces gathered at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Melindra
entities.description: Kor child in Drana's Orphans' Brigade.

entities.name: Orphans' Brigade
entities.description: Brigade of child warriors with Drana.

events.summary: Gideon sends Enkindi and his kitesailers to Guul Draz, where he meets Drana and tries to recruit her.
events.quote: Gideon sent Enkindi and his kitesailers to Guul Draz to look for any survivors

events.summary: Enkindi is horrified to see children among Drana's force, but Drana is unapologetic.
events.quote: Drana did not offer any apologies, calling them little warriors

events.summary: Enkindi leads his kitesailers into the head of the Sire of Stagnation, which tears off his head.
events.quote: The tentacle squeezed and tore the kor's head off, breaking his flight.

events.summary: Enkindi's sacrifice spares Melindra and other children, and Drana's survivors reach Gideon at Sea Gate.
events.quote: his sacrifice did help spare the lives of Melindra and many of the other warrior children

relations.quote: The tentacle squeezed and tore the kor's head off, breaking his flight.
Enkindi agreed to have his kitesailers join in the fight if only to save the children of the camp.
